body: Added .github/workflows/ci.yml Windows job: mingw-w64 + SDL2 mingw devel cross-compile of apps/client/src/main.c to WeaknightRacers.exe, bundled with SDL2.dll + generated run.bat into a zip artifact — same proven pattern as SHANKPIT's release.yml and REDGARDEN's ci.yml. Added missing _WIN32/winsock2 guards (WSAStartup/ioctlsocket/closesocket) to apps/client/src/main.c, ported from SHANKPIT apps/lobby/src/main.c — the file had zero Windows portability before this, mingw would have failed on raw POSIX socket headers. Server stays Linux-only, matching both sibling repos. Verified the Linux gcc build still compiles clean after the edits (no mingw available locally, no sudo — cross-compile itself validated via CI, same as SHANKPIT/REDGARDEN's own workflow). Commit WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS b4fa80d.
title: WEAKNIGHT_BEDROCK_RACERS: Windows client artifacts now match SHANKPIT/REDGARDEN pattern
